contract_answer.question: Does the unchanged NaFadeNet confirmation beat CPMLP on Na-ion split 42 while improving prefix behavior and prediction spread?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independent recomputation from all 600 saved predictions confirms that NA-E004 beats the same-split CPMLP NA-E001: MAPE 0.206247 versus 0.233727 (-0.027479), RMSE 58.0577 versus 62.5271 cycles (-4.4694), and Acc@15 0.383333 versus 0.346667 (+0.036667). Prefix MAPE improves in every bin by 0.006418-0.043856 and declines from 0.257100 at prefixes 1-10 to 0.199439 at 76-100, although it bottoms at 0.186466 for 51-75 and late-prefix RMSE is 1.8819 cycles worse than CPMLP. The spread prediction is not supported: prediction/target SD is 0.468647 versus CPMLP's 0.482697, and bias is slightly more negative at -28.7114 versus -26.8075 cycles. This valid confirmation is KEEP evidence for the candidate, but promotion still requires split 2024 and the predeclared three-split mean improvement.

main_symptom: NaFadeNet improves split-42 sample MAPE, RMSE, and Acc@15 over CPMLP and raises prediction-target correlation from 0.468203 to 0.636312, but predictions remain strongly compressed (spread 0.468647) and underpredicted (bias -28.7114 cycles). Its late-prefix behavior is mixed: MAPE improves versus CPMLP, while 76-100 RMSE worsens to 61.6240 from 59.7420 and bias worsens to -40.4578 from -20.0998 cycles.

contradicting_evidence: Overall prediction/target spread decreases from 0.482697 for NA-E001 to 0.468647 for NA-E004 rather than moving toward 1.
Cell 270040-1-8-57 is effectively unchanged at 0.316556 versus 0.316212 MAPE, and cell 270040-6-6-26 regresses by 0.018737 MAPE.
The run changes architecture and fitted seed together, so the saved artifacts cannot attribute the gain to a single internal NaFadeNet input without ablation.
causes.interpretation: The anchor-relative fade trajectory is the leading explanation for the same-split gain. Relative to CPMLP, it improves MAPE in all five prefix groups and raises target correlation by 0.168109. The largest cell gains occur on 270040-5-8-32 (-0.088024 MAPE), 270040-5-3-37 (-0.052266), and 270040-5-5-35 (-0.039978), consistent with improved discrimination across the wide split-42 EOL range. The evidence supports retaining the mechanism for the final confirmation, not yet causal attribution among anchor, explicit fade ratios, and TCN.
missing_evidence: The identical configuration's split-2024 result and the required three-split mean and sample standard deviation.
Matched use_anchor=false and use_fade=false ablations after confirmation to attribute the gain within NaFadeNet.
Repeated fits on the identical split-42 partition to separate seed variance from architecture effect.

contradicting_evidence: Prediction-target correlation improves substantially from 0.468203 to 0.636312.
NaFadeNet reduces overall RMSE by 4.4694 cycles and improves three of the four highest-error CPMLP cells.
No extreme predictions are reported, so the remaining error is not caused by unstable output outliers.
causes.interpretation: Split 42 still exposes mean compression across its 102-307-cycle target range. The two long-life cells 270040-1-8-57 and 270040-5-3-37 remain underpredicted with MAPE 0.316556 and 0.350126, while the 102-cycle cell 270040-5-8-32 remains overpredicted at 0.280095. These extreme cells keep overall spread below one half of target spread and explain why the improved ordering does not reach strong absolute calibration.
missing_evidence: Training-cell condition or nearest-neighbor evidence for the three extreme-EOL validation cells.
Cross-split evidence showing whether the same compression and signed-bias pattern persists on split 2024.
Cell-balanced training predictions at the selected checkpoint.

contradicting_evidence: The selected epoch-8 checkpoint improves every prefix-bin MAPE relative to NA-E001.
All monitored blocks have healthy finite gradients and updates, activations remain non-collapsed, and padding invariance is exact.
Validation MAPE after epoch 8 rises only to 0.219789 at epoch 13, much less sharply than NA-E003's split-2021 post-selection rise.
causes.interpretation: Additional late-cycle evidence is not converted into stable absolute calibration. MAPE improves through 51-75 cycles but rises at 76-100, where bias becomes -40.4578 cycles and RMSE exceeds CPMLP despite a lower MAPE. Continued train-loss decline after the selected epoch while validation remains worse makes mild small-sample overfit plausible, but the evidence also fits a representation or head calibration limit and does not localize a defective block.
missing_evidence: Per-cell prefix curves identifying which validation cells drive the 76-100 bias reversal.
Split-2024 late-prefix metrics under the identical configuration.
A later matched ablation separating mean pooling, last-observed pooling, and prefix fraction in the head.

layers.name: curve_enc
layers.role: Encode each observed V/I/Q cycle curve into a learned 32-dimensional state.
layers.reason: The encoder has finite connected gradients, late gradient/parameter ratio 0.003627, late update ratio 0.000385, zero near-zero-gradient fraction, and healthy active features. No repair is supported before completing confirmation.

layers.name: state_proj
layers.role: Fuse learned cycle state, anchor difference, and explicit capacity ratios into the 48-dimensional temporal state.
layers.reason: The projection remains healthy with late gradient/parameter ratio 0.002732, update ratio 0.000445, no dead gradients, and fully active finite outputs; the same-split MAPE improvement supports retention.

layers.name: tcn
layers.role: Read the masked anchor-relative trajectory through four causal residual temporal blocks.
layers.reason: The TCN has finite connected gradients, late gradient/parameter ratio 0.003410, late update ratio 0.000560, active non-collapsed features, and exact padding invariance. Mixed late-prefix calibration is not a health failure.

layers.name: tcn_norm
layers.role: Normalize features independently at each temporal position without mixing observed and padded cycles.
layers.reason: This is the smallest-gradient block but remains connected: late gradient/parameter ratio 0.000127, update ratio 0.0000341, zero near-zero-gradient fraction, and no padding sensitivity.

layers.name: head
layers.role: Combine masked mean, last-observed temporal state, and prefix fraction into standardized EOL.
layers.reason: The head has finite connected gradients, late gradient/parameter ratio 0.003223, late update ratio 0.000451, and healthy activations. Output compression warrants tracking and later ablation, but not repair before the final confirmation.

screen_floor.reason: NA-E004 is a full-candidate confirmation rather than a screening run, so the generic screen hard floor is not applicable. It completed 13 epochs, has HEALTHY gradients, and improves all three requested same-split headline metrics.

next_action.summary: Retain this valid split-42 confirmation and complete the unchanged NaFadeNet run on split 2024. Promote NaFadeNet only if the final three-split mean MAPE beats frozen CPMLP 0.1778 by at least 0.008; report mean plus sample standard deviation and continue tracking prediction compression and 76-100-cycle bias.
